outcome: changes in maternal vaginal and rectal microbiomes during the third trimester
microbial colonization of the neonate before birth
establishment of the neonatal microbiome after birth
cohort: 30 mothers and their neonates delivered by elective cesarean section
finding: The neonatal microbiome in infants delivered by cesarean section is distinct from maternal vaginal and rectal microbiomes at birth, indicating that postnatal exposure is the primary driver of initial microbiome development in this cohort.
mod_finding: The neonatal microbiome in infants delivered by cesarean section was distinct from maternal vaginal and rectal microbiomes at birth, indicating that postnatal exposure is the driving source of initial neonatal microbiome development.
